text:
marta_cs: Week0 triage for Hightide private VPC deploy. Audit logs are landing in S3 but our observability team reports gaps in the indexing. No immediate KMS Deny in CloudTrail. @chris_hightide can you confirm the CMK ARN and region?

chris_hightide: CMK is arn:aws:kms:us-east-2:444555666777:key/1a2b3c4d and the forwarder runs in us-west-2 (we used cross-region bucket replication). We also recently rotated keys per security policy.

diego_infra: Cross-region setups need either a multi-region key or separate regional CMKs with proper grants. If the forwarder is in us-west-2 but the key is a single-region key in us-east-2, Decrypt will fail unless replication decrypted first. Any DecryptionFailure in DLQ?

sam_support: DLQ shows entries with error 'KMS.DecryptFailed' and a note about 'incorrect key'. No explicit AccessDenied entries.

rina_sre: That pattern is consistent with rotation timing or a mismatch between encryption context values used during encryption and what the forwarder expects. Also check if the bucket replication preserves SSE-KMS IVs and that replication role has kms:Decrypt on the source key.

marta_cs: Actions: 1) @chris verify whether the CMK used is multi-region or single-region and whether replication is server-side-KMS with the same key or a different key on target region; 2) @diego provide a short checklist for cross-region KMS + replication; 3) @rina share quick decrypt CLI to test an object locally. I'll flag week0 health amber and set renewal-risk=medium until ingestion stabilizes.

opsbot: New ticket: CS-9907 — "Hightide: audit indexing gap — cross-region KMS/rotation check" (https://redwood.internal/tickets/CS-9907)

chris_hightide: We used server-side KMS on the producer side and enabled cross-region replication to our bucket in us-west-2. Rotation was executed yesterday and I suspect timing overlap. We can either: a) create a multi-region CMK and re-encrypt, or b) add a temporary grant to the new key. Which is faster?

diego_infra: Temporary grant + replay is fastest. Long-term we recommend multi-region key for replicas. Checklist snippet: ```
1) Confirm source CMK type (Multi-Region vs Single-Region)
2) If single-region, ensure replication role has kms:Decrypt on source CMK and kms:GenerateDataKey on target CMK
3) Prefer multi-region CMK for cross-region forwarders
4) On rotation, pause replication or coordinate rotation window to avoid mismatch
```

rina_sre: Decrypt test (run from forwarder host or an admin VM in target region): ```sh
# download object
aws s3 cp s3://hightide-audit-replica/path/to/object - > /tmp/obj.enc
# try decrypt with target region key id
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb:///tmp/obj.enc --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:444555666777:key/1a2b3c4d --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode > /tmp/decrypted.json
```

sam_support: Also flagging customer sentiment note: they called support and mentioned this hit their SOC dashboards. Marking renewal watch escalated if not green in 48h. We should proactively offer a joint runbook session.

marta_cs: Good catch. I'll propose a runbook + replay session within 6 hours. @chris can you add a temporary KMS grant scoped to the forwarder role and confirm when done? Also please paste one DLQ sample (redact any PII) into the ticket.

chris_hightide: Grant created and replay started. DLQ sample posted to CS-9907. Replay shows 60% of backlog successfully indexed so far. No AccessDenied logs in CloudTrail.

diego_infra: After replay, capture the failure signature (timestamp, error string) and add to onboarding runbook. We'll add a new checklist item: "coordinate CMK rotations during first-week replication windows".

rina_sre: I'll add an EncryptionContext check to the runbook too — mismatched context often slips in CI rotations.

marta_cs: Updating week0 health -> yellow, renewal risk = medium but mitigated. Scheduled joint runbook + replay review in 4 hours. Postmortem to include rotation coordination, multi-region CMK guidance, and temporary-grant playbook.

sam_support: Noting action: offer a complimentary 1-hour SRE call to Hightide. If we can get them to a stable state within 48h, we mark renewal risk back to low.

chris_hightide: Thanks all. Will report back after replay completes. Appreciated the quick turnaround.
